items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Well, I remember guys like Bobby Plater saying to me, you know that Basie would say, 'Yeah, yeah, make arrangements on it, and never call the numbers.

ctx.x: Then Basie never did play it. We later did a rehearsal on it. Ernie Wilkins made a little arrangement. And he didn't do too hot with it.
Well, I remember guys like Bobby Plater saying to me, you know that Basie would say, 'Yeah, yeah, make arrangements on it, and never call the numbers.
Oh, yeah, he would do that, he would do that.
